functions.comment_append: [driver-passthrough lot21 2026-10-02] ASM 0x45D29D..0x45D2C6 confirms the host re-emission sequence: opaque dispatch, end-pass, semitransparent dispatch, end-pass. [driver-passthrough lot21 2026-10-02] Textured-triangle replay evidence: preserve the emitted index/UV association and per-vertex RHW. For the v13 background, rot0 plus perspective-correct interpolation repairs shared edges; adding a C-A-B UV rotation breaks them. This is capture-scoped evidence, not a new packet-layout offset.

[driver-passthrough lot21 2026-10-02] Shared textured-primitive helper used by FT3, FT4 and two adjacent textured emitters. Masks CLUT to 15 bits, selects the host draw list by GPU code/TPage/CLUT/state, allocates one batch, optionally applies host-pass setup, and returns the selected list. It does not define cross-list painter order.

[driver-passthrough lot21 2026-10-02] This selector is the TPage/CLUT/pass/state rebucketing boundary; selecting a list does not preserve global PSX OT order across lists. Capture-derived logical resource offsets: 0x05AF00 = sky plus white cliff, 0x059E20 = near terrain, 0x058E40 = far terrain/horizon. They are normalized labels, not raw v13 texobj values and not static image addresses.

[driver-passthrough lot21 2026-10-02] Submission walks fixed render-pass/TPage/subslot lists and preserves order only within each list; there is no global depth merge. The offline background->actors->UI composite is a diagnostic policy, not an observed OT. In v13, direct slot-49 records are 4 shadows (96v/96i), cursor (6v/6i) and HP/status bars (16v/24i); texobj=0 is captured, while the inherited active binding is not serialized and remains unresolved.

[driver-passthrough lot21 2026-10-02] The linked-node walk preserves order inside one GfxDrawList only. It cannot reconstruct relative order between TPage/pass lists. Lot21 host-order replay obscures nearly all actors, which is capture-based offline negative evidence against treating captured submission order as a global painter order.

[driver-passthrough lot21 2026-10-02] End of one host primitive pass. If dword_B7CC20 is nonzero, tail-submits texture-page lists; otherwise flushes the current list then leaves the scene or restores blend mode 4/render target 0. Called after both opaque and semitransparent OT re-emission. It is not Present; all callers ignore EAX.

[driver-passthrough lot21 2026-10-02] Capture v13/build 0x5640 contains 16 TEXWIN records and all are (0,0,0,0), so strict replay applies no texture-window transform for this capture. This does not prove a general W_window and does not promote the existing lot17 UNPROVEN width candidate.
